triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: The v2 record union declares exhaustive per-operation field sets with always-present nullable chain fields and a CANON recordDigest; RedEvidenceData widens to a mixed v1/v2 array with unchanged on-disk layout; and redEvidenceRecordSatisfied skips every non-v1 record so the live enforce gate produces byte-identical diagnostics on a v1-only store (RED signal A).

Chain head resolves by both uniqueness conjuncts; the three integrity checks run with fork rejection carrying a reason id distinct from the prior-digest check; the closed transition table governs quarantine/recover with cycle-safe transitive effective-head resolution; and the three operation-key preimages plus deterministic OP-first12hex-seq ids are derived per section 3.4.

The append pipeline runs the mandated order (derive key, dedupe, replay short-circuit, head, transition, integrity, append); the dedupe search is scoped so a quarantined record cannot swallow a deliberate replacement; and all four appends serialize under one mkdir claim so two racing quarantines yield exactly one record and a unique head (RED signal B).

red_evidence_quarantine and red_evidence_recover append control records with a derived approvedBy and the section 4.1 reference-validation state machine; red_evidence_binding_set enforces the binding freeze once a run record exists on an unquarantined chain; and the committed chain smoke registered in lattice.config.json plus the two-command wiring cover the full rejection matrix (RED signal C).

note: W2c v2 chain plane: 4 acceptance bindings cover all 11 checklist items and 88 verificationIntents; the three RED signals (live enforce-gate crash, two-process race, hashed rejection matrix) are the convergence anchor.
